description: This file contains a JUnit test class for verifying compatibility between Log4J 1.x and Log4J 2.x logging APIs in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing that Log4J 1.x style logging works with Log4J 2.x implementations.

classes.name: Log4JCompatibilityTest
classes.description: JUnit test class to check compatibility of Log4J 1.x API with Log4J 2.x.

methods.name: OpenmrsCore_shouldAllowUseOfLog4j1xAPI
methods.description: Test method which verifies that a message logged via the Log4J 1.x API appears in the Log4J 2.x logger with proper configuration.
